players.product: General-purpose and automotive MLCC (plus film DC-link / power capacitors and single-layer ceramic capacitors)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 155,700 million, up 3% year on year - MLCC KRW 82,255 million (52.8%), film capacitors (power and automotive) KRW 48,719 million, single-layer ceramic capacitors KRW 12,709 million, other KRW 12,017 million; exports KRW 108,961 million (69.98%). Q2 2026 revenue KRW 82,846,780,037 and operating profit KRW 8,637,921,253 (H1 operating profit KRW 13,334,863,674).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 155,700 million (+3%); MLCC KRW 82,255 million

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 average utilisation 90.0% at the Yongin plant and 58.1% at overseas plants; H1 capacity 14,410 Mpcs (KRW 135,978 million), output 12,790 Mpcs (KRW 112,273 million).
Half-year report: H1 2026 capacitor orders KRW 157,552 million, deliveries KRW 155,700 million, order backlog KRW 1,852 million at 06-30-2026.

Half-year report: 2026 investment plan at the Yongin plant KRW 11,425 million (manufacturing equipment for capacity increase KRW 8,464 million), of which KRW 5,123 million spent in H1; the company says further investment will proceed cautiously, taking downstream industry and customer trends into account.

Company outlook (half-year report): the spread of AI servers and on-device AI devices is structurally increasing demand for high-capacity, ultra-small components, and the company expects growth centred on high-value products; for power film capacitors it expects power-equipment demand to stay robust over the mid to long term on AI / data centre and transmission-distribution investment; automotive MLCC demand expected to keep growing.

Half-year report R&D: projects include a data centre supercapacitor module, graphene-based ultra-high-capacity MLCC, high-voltage / high-capacity EV MLCC and thin capacitors under 100um thick; the company targets entry into power AI and data centre markets.

Half-year report customer concentration: two unnamed customers over 10% of revenue - customer A KRW 37,428,333 thousand and customer B KRW 21,598,918 thousand in H1 2026 (KRW 25,226,248 thousand and KRW 18,680,339 thousand in H1 2025).

Samwha Capacitor.why: Korean capacitor maker whose largest product is MLCC (52.8% of H1 2026 revenue); expects AI server demand to lift high-capacity, ultra-small component demand.
Samwha Capacitor.evidence: Samwha Capacitor Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026): H1 2026 MLCC revenue KRW 82,255 million (52.8%); AI servers and on-device AI structurally increasing demand for high-capacity, ultra-small components.
